unit_notes: 8 ok, 0 error, 1 uncertain. The one uncertain question (19a48bc74a, Langevin) has a date that runs ahead of the record: quartz-transmitted pulses hunting submarines belong to 1918, not 'by 1917' (Physics Today says the 1917 system still sent its beam from mica). Fix: 'By 1918'. Its context's 1,300 m range is one source's figure among several (1,300 m, about 1,500 m, over 2.7 km); 'more than a kilometre' is safe. The stem's half-wave logic for noise-cancelling headphones (66d714be46) is right: an inverted wave delayed half a wave is back in step and adds, while a whole-wave delay would still cancel.
